intended_use: Automated resume screening and candidate ranking against job descriptions. Reduces recruiter screening time by 60-70%. Intended for use as a decision-support tool — human review required before final hiring decisions.
out_of_scope: Not designed for: (1) final hiring decisions without human review, (2) resumes in languages other than English, (3) roles outside the 24 supported job categories.
ethical_considerations: Model trained on text only. Resume screening can perpetuate bias if training data reflects historical hiring patterns. Regular fairness audits recommended. Model outputs must be reviewed by qualified HR professionals before use in hiring.
limitations: Dataset size (~2.4k resumes) is small — model may not generalise to niche or senior-level roles
Text-only: ignores portfolio links, GitHub activity, certifications not mentioned in resume body
24 fixed job categories — open-domain JDs not supported
May exhibit keyword-stuffing vulnerability — candidates padding resumes with JD terms

monitoring.recommended_retrain_trigger: Retrain when: (1) PSI > 0.20 on token_count or keyword_density, (2) F1_macro drops > 5% in A/B production test, (3) new job category emerges in hiring data
